liveClass.title: Hayat çizgisi
liveClass.goal: Her öğrenci kendi hayatından 6 olayı (biri uydurma) bir zaman çizgisine yazar. Eşi Did you...? / When did you...? sorularıyla her olayı sorar ve uydurma olanı bulmaya çalışır. Sonra öğrenciler eşlerinin hayat hikâyesini sınıfa üçüncü tekil kişiyle anlatır.

lessons.title: Düzensiz fiiller (1)
lessons.goal: En sık kullanılan düzensiz fiillerle geçmişi anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Bir ödülün hikâyesi
discover.body:
Aylin Kaya was born in Kars in 1990. Her family didn't have much money, but her mother gave her a camera for her tenth birthday.

Aylin took photos of everything: animals, people, the snow. At eighteen she went to Istanbul to study art. She didn't know anybody there, but she made friends quickly.

In 2019 she saw a competition online. She sent three photos of her village. Six months later she won first prize. Today her photos are in museums in Paris and New York.

questions.prompt: Who gave Aylin her first camera?
What did she send to the competition?
questions.explanation: "She sent three photos of her village."

learn.explanation:
A1'de düzenli fiilleri (-ed) ve iki düzensiz fiili (went, had) gördük. İngilizcede yaklaşık 100 sık kullanılan düzensiz fiil vardır ve ezberlenmeleri gerekir. Bu ünitede en sık kullanılan 20'siyle başlıyoruz.

| Fiil | Geçmiş | | Fiil | Geçmiş |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| go | **went** | | see | **saw** |
| have | **had** | | take | **took** |
| get | **got** | | give | **gave** |
| make | **made** | | send | **sent** |
| do | **did** | | know | **knew** |
| come | **came** | | think | **thought** |

Düzensiz fiiller de **her özne için aynıdır**: I went, she went, they went.

**Olumsuz ve soruda** yine did + yalın fiil: She **didn't know** anybody. / **Did** you **see** it?

examples.en: We took a taxi to the airport.
I thought it was a good idea.
She didn't come to the party.

learn.turkishNote: Düzensiz fiilleri ezberlemenin en iyi yolu onları anlamlı cümlelerle tekrar etmektir. Uygulamadaki kelime kartları her fiili bir örnek cümleyle verir; aralıklı tekrar sistemi unutmaya başladığınız fiilleri size tekrar gösterir. "didn't went" A2'de bile çok sık yapılan bir hatadır: did geçmişi zaten gösterir, fiil yalın kalır.

learn.explanation:
**Yaşam olaylarında sık kullanılan düzensiz fiiller:**

| Fiil | Geçmiş | | Fiil | Geçmiş |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| meet | **met** | | grow up | **grew up** |
| become | **became** | | leave | **left** |
| buy | **bought** | | begin | **began** |
| write | **wrote** | | win | **won** |
| fall | **fell** | | wear | **wore** |
| find | **found** | | sell | **sold** |

**Gruplar halinde öğrenmek kolaylaştırır:**

- -ought / -aught: buy → bought, think → thought, bring → brought, teach → taught
- i → a: begin → began, swim → swam, sing → sang, drink → drank
- değişmeyenler: put → put, cut → cut, cost → cost

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "olmak" fiili çok geniş kullanılır; İngilizcede karşılığı duruma göre değişir: doktor oldu = became a doctor, evlendi = got married, bebeği oldu = had a baby. "Evlendi" için "married with" değil, "got married to" kullanılır.

learn.explanation:
**Evet/hayır sorusu:** Did + özne + yalın fiil?

- **Did** you **grow up** here? – Yes, I **did**. / No, I **didn't**.

**Bilgi sorusu:** Soru kelimesi + did + özne + yalın fiil?

| Soru kelimesi | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Where | Where **did** you **go** to school? |
| When | When **did** she **move** to Ankara? |
| Why | Why **did** they **leave**? |
| How | How **did** you **meet**? |
| What | What **did** you **study**? |
| How long | How long **did** you **live** there? |

**Doğum:** be born bir be yapısıdır, did kullanılmaz:

- **Where were** you **born**? (~~Where did you born?~~)
- **When was** he **born**?

examples.en: What did you study at university?
How long did you live in Germany?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "doğdum" etken bir fiil gibidir; İngilizcede "be born" edilgendir: I was born. Bu yüzden "Where did you born?" yanlıştır, "Where were you born?" doğrudur. Ayrıca "üniversitede ne okudun?" sorusunda read değil study kullanılır.

lessons.title: Kim yaptı?
lessons.goal: Özne soruları ile nesne sorularını ayırt edebilirim.

discover.title: Bilgi yarışması
discover.body:
QUIZ NIGHT – Round 3: Famous people

1. Who painted the Mona Lisa?
2. Who discovered penicillin?
3. What happened in Turkey in 1923?
4. Who wrote 'The Black Book'?
5. Who did Mimar Sinan build the Süleymaniye Mosque for?

Answers: 1. Leonardo da Vinci painted it. 2. Alexander Fleming discovered it in 1928. 3. The Republic of Turkey began. 4. Orhan Pamuk wrote it. 5. He built it for Sultan Süleyman.

learn.explanation:
**Who** ve **What** iki farklı soru sorabilir:

**1. Özne sorusu** (yapanı soruyoruz): did **kullanılmaz**, fiil geçmiş halde kalır.

- **Who wrote** 'Snow'? – Orhan Pamuk wrote it.
- **What happened**? – I lost my wallet.

**2. Nesne sorusu** (eylemin yapıldığı kişiyi/şeyi soruyoruz): did **kullanılır**.

- **Who did** you **see** at the party? – I saw Ayşe.
- **What did** she **buy**? – She bought a coat.

**Karşılaştırın:**

| Özne sorusu | Nesne sorusu |
|---|---|
| Who called you? (Seni kim aradı?) | Who did you call? (Sen kimi aradın?) |
| Who met Ali? (Ali'yle kim buluştu?) | Who did Ali meet? (Ali kiminle buluştu?) |
learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "kim" ve "kimi" farklı kelimelerdir, bu yüzden fark kolay anlaşılır: "Kim aradı?" = Who called? (özne), "Kimi aradın?" = Who did you call? (nesne). "What did happen?" yanlıştır; happen her zaman özne sorusudur: What happened?

2. Who invented the light bulb? – Edison invented it.
3. What happened in 1969? – People walked on the moon.
4. What did Marie Curie discover? – She discovered radium.
5. Which city did Mehmed II conquer in 1453? – He conquered Istanbul.

lessons.title: Bir hayat hikâyesi
lessons.goal: Bir hayat hikâyesini zaman ifadeleriyle sıralı ve akıcı bir şekilde anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Kısa biyografi: Sabiha Gökçen
discover.body:
Sabiha Gökçen was born in Bursa in 1913. When she was twelve, she met Atatürk and he adopted her.

In 1935 she went to a flying school and fell in love with planes. Only a year later, at the age of 23, she became the first Turkish woman pilot. In 1937 she flew military planes, and she became the world's first woman combat pilot.

Later, she flew to many Balkan countries. She taught young pilots for many years. She died in 2001, but today one of Istanbul's airports has her name.

questions.prompt: How old was Sabiha Gökçen when she became a pilot?
questions.explanation: "at the age of 23, she became the first Turkish woman pilot"
"one of Istanbul's airports has her name"

learn.explanation:
Bir hayat hikâyesini akıcı anlatmak için zaman ifadeleri kullanırız:

| İfade | Örnek |
|---|---|
| in + yıl | She was born **in** 1913. |
| on + tarih | He died **on** 10 November 1938. |
| when + I/she was ... | **When she was** twelve, she met Atatürk. |
| at the age of ... | **At the age of** 23, she became a pilot. |
| ... later | Two years **later**, they got married. |
| after + isim / -ing | **After** university, he moved to London. |
| then / after that | **Then** she started teaching. |
| from ... to ... | He lived in Paris **from** 1990 **to** 2005. |

**Yıl okumak:** 1913 = nineteen thirteen, 2001 = two thousand and one, 2015 = twenty fifteen

examples.en: When I was a teenager, I wanted to be a pilot.
After school, she worked in a bank.
A year later, he won the Nobel Prize.
examples.tr: Bir yıl sonra Nobel ödülü kazandı.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "iki yıl sonra" deriz; İngilizcede geçmişi anlatırken "two years later" ya da "after two years" denir. "on iki yaşındayken" = when she was twelve (when she was twelve years old da olur).

task.modelAnswer: I was born in Samsun in 1994. When I was eight, my family moved to Ankara because my father got a new job there. I grew up in Çankaya and went to a great school. At the age of eighteen, I began university in Izmir and studied engineering. After university, I found a job in a big company. In 2021 I met my wife, and two years later we got married. questions.modelAnswer: My best friend Selin was born in Eskişehir in 1996. She grew up with three brothers. When she was ten, she won a painting competition. She went to university in Istanbul and studied architecture. After university, she got a job in Berlin. Two years later she started her own company. Last summer she came back to Turkey and opened an office in Izmir.
